title: Washington Post reporter hunts for information on the psychic spying program
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Washington Post reporter hunts for information on the psychic spying program, about 1970s-1990s at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: started covering hunting for information on the psychic buying program

plain: Joe McMoneagle talks about a US government programme that tried to use psychics as spies. He says that at some point between the 1970s and the 1990s, a reporter from the Washington Post newspaper in Washington, DC started digging for information on it. If that is right, the secret programme was close to being exposed in the press.
